title: Lefschetz recruited for nonlinear group, later moved to Brown

tellings.quote: why was solomon left schetz the great topologist recruited to be involved with louis whitten and to have an entire non-linear group working on mathematics that then gets moved to brown university when i believe that these programs are sunsetted

plain: In the 1950s, Solomon Lefschetz, a great mathematician of shapes and spaces, was recruited to work alongside the physicist Louis Witten at the Glenn Martin Company, an aircraft maker, leading a whole group doing a hard kind of math called nonlinear mathematics, and that group was later moved to Brown University. The mathematician Eric Weinstein raises this as a question, without naming a source, and says he believes the move came when these programs were shut down, which would suggest the aircraft industry was quietly running serious physics research, perhaps on gravity.
